prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a romantic European fine-art portrait of a generic adult woman with natural soft porcelain skin, loosely gathered messy bun, soft volume and flyaways framing her face, delicate dangling pearl earrings and a calm distant introspective gaze. Her upper body faces camera while her head turns gently left. She wears an opaque black structured bodice beneath an intricate black floral lace overlay draped over shoulders and collarbone, with a refined haute-couture silhouette. Set her in a historic European castle garden with ancient stone walls, ivy-covered arches, classical statues, trimmed hedges and stone paths in late-afternoon soft daylight. Use side light from camera-right, gentle shadows, low painterly contrast, a centered vertical medium close-up, 85mm portrait look and shallow depth of field. Do not reproduce any named public-figure likeness.
